description: This is a Python script for a command-line interface tool to initialize various software projects based on templates. It parses CLI arguments, constructs project configurations, retrieves template information, and outputs configuration details or commands for project setup. It supports multiple project types and has functionalities for generating project templates and fetching run commands.

classes.name: TemplateInitInfo
classes.description: Class holding template initialization configuration details.

classes.name: ProjectType
classes.description: Class or Enum for project type with method from_string.

classes.name: ProjectInitializer
classes.description: Class responsible for creating templates and initializing projects.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] parse_parameters(params_str: str)
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string of key=value pairs into a dictionary with proper types.

methods.name: ProjectConfig create_project_config(args)
methods.description: Creates a ProjectConfig object from CLI arguments.

methods.name: ProjectConfig create_minimal_project_config(project_type: str, parameters: str = None)
methods.description: Creates a basic ProjectConfig for retrieving template info.

methods.name: str make_path_absolute(path: str, base_path: Path)
methods.description: Converts a relative path to an absolute path based on a base directory.

methods.name: dict template_init_info_to_dict(init_info: TemplateInitInfo, project_path: Path)
methods.description: Converts TemplateInitInfo object into a dictionary with absolute paths for JSON serialization.

methods.name: output_json(success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_path: Path = None)
methods.description: Outputs the result as a JSON-formatted string for success or failure.

methods.name: output_get_run_command(project_type: str, run_command: str)
methods.description: Outputs the run command for a given project type in JSON format.

methods.name: handle_get_run_command(args)
methods.description: Handles the logic for retrieving the run command for a specific project type.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main function parsing CLI arguments and orchestrating project initialization or command retrieval.
